verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs claim versioned forecasts and scenario modeling. They also claim headcount planning backed by live HRIS/ATS data, which could support a hiring-wave scenario. Variance analysis may enable comparisons, but the only evidence is a single llms.txt line, with no detail on building named scenarios or viewing them side by side. Missing for 10: documented workflow for creating multiple scenarios (downside case, slipped quarter), explicit side-by-side scenario comparison view, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
